headline: Healthcare Global Enterprises: SEBI Takeover Regulations Disclosure Filing
sum: Healthcare Global Enterprises Limited filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 Regulation 31(4), indicating a material takeover or acquisition event requiring regulatory transparency.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is the mandatory gating item for any open offer or substantial acquisition above 25% threshold; the acquirer's formal disclosure anchors the timeline for public shareholders' protection under Indian takeover law.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 16 June 2026 under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure when a person acquires or agrees to acquire shares that would give them 25% or more of voting rights. The specific parties, consideration, share count, and acquisition structure are not disclosed in the accessible version of the filing.
